failures.root_cause:
Two concurrent `transfer` calls read the same balance before either writes it back. `ledger::transfer` checks `balance >= amount` and then subtracts without holding `accounts_lock`, so both withdrawals pass the check.

Introduced by 9f1e2d3 ("refactor ledger to use per-account locks") which dropped the outer lock. cc @acme/bank-team

![tracking](https://evil.example/track.png)
